Petitioners contend that they are the owners of a two storied commercial building in the aforenoted property,
which houses various commercial establishments pursuant to lease W.P.(C). No.2072 OF 2026 2026:KER:8515 arrangements with tenants.

In the meanwhile, according to the petitioners,
respondents had decided to relocate a bus stop to the place in front of petitioners' building, thereby blocking its view to the public and causing serious prejudice.
Petitioners also contend that the building is situated on the side of the State Highway and that unless the view of petitioners building is not obstructed they would be put to serious prejudice.

3. A statement has been filed on behalf of the 3 rd respondent pointing out that in front of petitioners property situated at Kilometer 18+550 LHS Mapranam, there is already a bus shelter in existence and as per the approved DPR, the new bus shelter is being put up exactly at the same location.
It is also stated that the location for the new bus shelter is marked at the same spot of the existing one and it has been marked in such a way that it will not affect the access to the property.

The statement also mentions that utmost care was taken while fixing the location and it is being constructed without causing any difficulty to any person.
4. The 3rd respondent further stated that the petitioner had not sent any representation against the construction of the bus shelter and after the petitioner telephoned the 3 rd W.P.(C). No.2072 OF 2026 2026:KER:8515 respondent, they have even reduced the size of the bus shelter by one meter from the existing bus shelter.
It is also stated that thereafter though petitioners were satisfied with the above, they have now turned around and filed the writ petition.

5. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned counsel for respondents 1 to 3.
6.
The bus shelter is being constructed at the exact spot where the earlier bus shelter was existing.

It was submitted that the bus shelter is designed in such a way that there will be a transparent wall,
which would not cause any serious disruption to the view of the petitioners.
7. The direction not to construct a bus stop in front of a building is not a matter which should be considered by this Court as the design, the size and the location of bus stops are all matters to be Mrs. Ramya Bijoy vs Irinjalakuda Municipality on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110888024/
3 decided by the appropriate authority.

If this Court starts interfering even with the location and the design of such bus shelters, there would be no end to such litigations and the entire project work being carried on by respondents 2 and 3 would come to standstill.
Therefore, this Court declines to issue any direction in the matter.

Moreover, the grievance of the petitioner stands redressed by the very fact that the W.P.(C). No.2072 OF 2026 2026:KER:8515 proposed bus shelter is going to be constructed using transparent walls in the same location as the existing bus shelter.

In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed of without issuing any specific directions to the respondents, and by recording the submission of the learned counsel for the 3 rd respondent, which would to a large extent redress the grievance of the petitioners.

Sd/-
